title: 初二短对话：广播与午餐
source_notice: 初二普通期末公开卷具体结构已核；主卷三节5/5/5与参考键合写后10题标题冲突保留。正文地域未知、学校原版未认证；首5脚本完整而后段截断，原录音缺，不当gold。本稿为完整原创配套，未通过独立教研/学生/商用或生产验证。
instruction: 听五段短对话，每段一题，选A、B、C中的最佳答案。每段只读一遍，听后留10秒；审阅可重播。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Will you write stories for a newspaper when you leave school, Lily?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I enjoy writing, but I want to read the news on the radio. My uncle works there, and I visited him last week.

questions.stem: What does Lily want to do?
questions.rationale: A：是男方提出的设想，被but转折排除；B：她明确说want to read the news on the radio；C：没有教写作的职业计划

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Why did you miss the first lesson, Ben? Was the bus late?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. I got on the bus to the sports centre by mistake. I had to get off and walk back.

questions.rationale: A：坐错去运动中心的车并走回；B：没有故障；C：没有睡过头

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Did you cycle to the pool yesterday, Emma?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Usually I do, but it was raining hard. Dad was using the car, so I went on foot with a big umbrella.

questions.stem: How did Emma go to the pool yesterday?
questions.rationale: A：是平常方式，昨天例外；B：车由爸爸使用；C：明确went on foot

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Do you practise the piano every evening, Tom?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. I practise on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. On the other days I work on my school newspaper.

questions.stem: How often does Tom practise the piano?
questions.rationale: A：被No否定；B：周一三六合每周三次；C：漏计另外两天

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Can we sit at that table by the window?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes. I will bring you the menus. Today we have tomato soup and fresh bread, if you would like a quick lunch.

questions.rationale: A：桌位、菜单与午餐共同定位；B：无等车活动；C：无图书交易
